transcript.text: Hello, Daniel, thanks for coming in. I'm Helen, and I coordinate the volunteers at the Northside Food Bank. Let's go through your application form together.
transcript.speaker: HELEN

transcript.text: Thanks, Helen. I'm looking forward to getting started.
transcript.speaker: DANIEL

transcript.text: We have a great team, and many of our volunteers have been with us for years.
transcript.speaker: HELEN

transcript.text: First, I need to check your name. Is it Daniel Whitcombe?
transcript.speaker: HELEN

transcript.text: Yes, that's right, though it's spelled W-H-I-T-C-O-M-B-E, with a B at the end. People often miss it.
transcript.speaker: DANIEL

transcript.text: Thank you. And you said you're free on weekday evenings?
transcript.speaker: HELEN

transcript.text: That's right, Monday to Thursday after six. I work during the day, so I can't help in the mornings.
transcript.speaker: DANIEL

transcript.text: Good. Weekday evenings are when we are busiest, because people finish work and come to collect their food boxes.
transcript.speaker: HELEN

transcript.text: That makes sense. I'm used to working in the evenings from my restaurant days.
transcript.speaker: DANIEL

transcript.text: That's perfect, as most of our deliveries come in the evening. And your contact email?
transcript.speaker: HELEN

transcript.text: It's daniel dot w at northmail dot com. The w is just the initial.
transcript.speaker: DANIEL

transcript.text: Got it. Now, do you have any previous experience in this kind of work?
transcript.speaker: HELEN

transcript.text: I used to work in a restaurant kitchen, so I'm comfortable with food hygiene and handling stock.
transcript.speaker: DANIEL

transcript.text: Excellent, that's very useful. And can I ask what made you want to volunteer here?
transcript.speaker: HELEN

transcript.text: Honestly, a friend of mine used the food bank last winter, and it really helped her. I wanted to give something back.
transcript.speaker: DANIEL

transcript.text: Many of our volunteers have a similar story. Once you've seen how much a box of food can help, you want to come back.
transcript.speaker: HELEN

transcript.text: I can imagine. I'm hoping I can bring a couple of friends along as well.
transcript.speaker: DANIEL

transcript.text: That's a lovely reason. Now, let me explain our weekly schedule so you can choose. On Monday evenings, the main task is sorting the donations that come in at the weekend.
transcript.speaker: HELEN

transcript.text: I'd be happy to do that. What about the other days?
transcript.speaker: DANIEL

transcript.text: Tuesday is for checking dates on all the tins and packets. It's a vital task, because we must never give out food that has expired. Wednesday is packing the boxes for families, which needs three or four people.
transcript.speaker: HELEN

transcript.text: That sounds like a good team activity.
transcript.speaker: DANIEL

transcript.text: It is. Thursday is the day we welcome the clients when they come to collect their boxes. You need to be friendly and patient, as some people feel embarrassed about coming.
transcript.speaker: HELEN

transcript.text: I understand. I'd like to try that, if it's possible.
transcript.speaker: DANIEL

transcript.text: It's one of the hardest jobs, but also the most rewarding. People often come back to say thank you.
transcript.speaker: HELEN

transcript.text: I'll make sure I smile and listen carefully.
transcript.speaker: DANIEL

transcript.text: Of course. And on Fridays, which is outside your availability, we do the deliveries to people who cannot leave their homes. Perhaps another time.
transcript.speaker: HELEN

transcript.text: Maybe in the future. Is there any training?
transcript.speaker: DANIEL

transcript.text: There is a short training evening next week, where we explain safety rules and how to talk to clients. I'll send you the details. Welcome to the team, Daniel.
transcript.speaker: HELEN

transcript.text: Thank you, Helen. I'm really glad to be joining you.
transcript.speaker: DANIEL

transcript.text: So are we. See you next week.
transcript.speaker: HELEN
